_source: All files are from the Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged HF repo (split_files/*), the same source ComfyUI's official Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B template uses. filename/type/save_path are read directly off the workflow JSON node inputs.

models.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
models.description: Loaded by UNETLoader (node 37), image-to-video latent via Wan22ImageToVideoLatent (node 55) at 1280x704, length 121

models.name: UMT5-XXL text encoder (fp8 scaled)
models.description: Loaded by CLIPLoader (node 38), type=wan. Same file also used by the Fun Control 14B machine — worth caching once and pointing both machines at the same source. ComfyUI resolves CLIPLoader from both models/clip and models/text_encoders.

models.name: Wan 2.2 VAE
models.description: Loaded by VAELoader (node 39). Correctly uses 'wan2.2_vae.safetensors' — the Fun Control 14B workflow instead loads 'wan_2.1_vae.safetensors'. Both are intentional and match ComfyUI's official Wan 2.2 templates (TI2V 5B -> 2.2 VAE, Fun Control 14B -> 2.1 VAE).
